product_overview: Eduplay is a teacher-first educational platform for creating, managing, and delivering language-learning games, courses, and vocabulary activities. Teachers can upload lesson materials, generate game content with AI, and assign interactive exercises to students who play free via join code.
core_goals: Enable secure teacher authentication with persistent sessions and password recovery
Allow teachers to upload lessons and generate structured course content with AI
Support manual and AI-assisted creation of multiple educational game types
Provide vocabulary, grammar, listening, and speaking exercise workflows aligned to course content
Let teachers manage classes, assign work, and track student progress
Enable publishing, browsing, and purchasing of games through a marketplace
Support subscription billing, admin controls, branding, media uploads, and course management

features.name: Authentication
features.description: Users can register, verify email, log in, stay signed in across browser restarts, and recover forgotten passwords using verification codes.
user_flows: POST /api/auth/register with valid user details -> Receive 200 Created user -> POST /api/auth/verify with verification code -> Receive 200 verified account -> GET/POST /api/auth/[...nextauth] with credentials -> Receive active JWT-backed session
POST /api/auth/register with an email that already exists -> Receive 409 Email already registered -> User is prevented from creating a duplicate account

POST /api/auth/forgot-password with a registered email -> Receive 200 with reset code sent -> POST /api/auth/verify-reset-code with valid code -> Receive 200 code verified -> POST /api/auth/reset-password with new password -> Receive 200 password updated
POST /api/auth/forgot-password with unknown email or expired code flow -> Receive error response -> User cannot continue until a valid code is requested or re-sent

features.name: AI Course and Game Generation
features.description: Teachers can upload lesson files and use AI to extract key words, grammar rules, and learning content that powers game and vocabulary generation.
user_flows: POST /api/ai/generate with authenticated teacher, uploaded lesson file, target language, level, and selected game type -> Receive generated structured content -> Content is saved and used to create lesson-ready games and vocabulary
POST /api/ai/generate-game with authenticated teacher and valid lesson context -> Receive AI-generated game draft -> Game is linked to the teacher's course workflow
POST /api/ai/vocabulary with authenticated teacher and lesson text -> Receive vocabulary set suggestions -> Teacher can reuse the generated set in multiple activities
POST /api/ai/generate with unsupported file type, missing file, or invalid session -> Receive validation error or 401/400 -> No generation is created

features.name: Game Management
features.description: Teachers can create, view, update, delete, play-track, and publish educational games, including multiple games attached to a course.
user_flows: POST /api/games with authenticated teacher, game data, and optional vocabularySetId -> Receive 200 created game -> GET /api/games -> Receive list including the new game -> GET /api/games/[id] -> Receive saved game details
PATCH /api/games/[id] with valid updates -> Receive 200 updated game -> GET /api/games/[id] -> See updated configuration and content
POST /api/games/[id]/play with progress data -> Receive 200 play progress saved -> Student progress is recorded for later analytics
POST /api/games/[id]/publish with publishable game data -> Receive 200 published game -> Game becomes available in marketplace or student play views
DELETE /api/games/[id] for an owned game -> Receive 200 deleted game -> GET /api/games/[id] -> Receive not found or access error
POST /api/games/[id] with invalid ownership, missing fields, or unsupported type -> Receive 403/400 error -> Game is not created or changed

features.name: Vocabulary Management
features.description: Teachers can manage reusable vocabulary sets and items that support flashcards, matching, fill-in-the-gap, and other vocabulary activities.
user_flows: POST /api/vocabulary with valid set name and metadata -> Receive 200 created vocabulary set -> POST /api/vocabulary/[id]/items with word data -> Receive 200 item added -> GET /api/vocabulary/[id] -> Receive set with items
GET /api/vocabulary -> Receive list of vocabulary sets for the authenticated teacher -> Teacher can select one set for reuse across multiple games
PATCH /api/vocabulary/[id] with edited title or description -> Receive 200 updated set -> GET /api/vocabulary/[id] -> See changes reflected
POST /api/vocabulary/[id]/items with missing word fields or invalid set id -> Receive validation error or 404 -> Item is not created
DELETE /api/vocabulary/[id] for an existing set -> Receive 200 deleted set -> GET /api/vocabulary/[id] -> Receive not found

features.name: Classes and Student Management
features.description: Teachers can create classes, let students join by code, assign work, and manage class membership and live activities.
user_flows: POST /api/classes with teacher credentials and class details -> Receive 200 class created -> POST /api/classes/join with class code -> Receive 200 student joined -> GET /api/classes/[id] -> Receive class details and members
GET /api/classes -> Receive class list for the authenticated teacher -> Teacher opens a class and views students and assignments
PATCH /api/classes/[id] with updated class name or settings -> Receive 200 class updated -> GET /api/classes/[id] -> Receive new class configuration
POST /api/classes/[id]/assign with valid game or lesson reference -> Receive 200 assignment created -> Students can access assigned work
POST /api/classes/join with invalid or expired code -> Receive error response -> Student remains outside the class

features.name: Student Progress Tracking
features.description: Teachers can review student progress, award XP, and assign badges based on completed class activities and game performance.
user_flows: GET /api/progress -> Receive overview of progress data -> GET /api/progress/[studentId] -> Receive individual student progress details
POST /api/progress/[studentId]/xp with valid student and XP amount -> Receive 200 XP awarded -> GET /api/progress/[studentId] -> See updated total XP
POST /api/progress/[studentId]/badges with valid badge data -> Receive 200 badge awarded -> GET /api/progress/[studentId] -> Badge appears in student record
POST /api/progress/[studentId]/xp with invalid studentId or unauthorized teacher -> Receive error response -> No progress change occurs

features.name: Marketplace
features.description: Teachers can browse, purchase, and sell published games, while admins review pending marketplace submissions before approval.
user_flows: GET /api/marketplace -> Receive list of published games -> Teacher browses available marketplace items
POST /api/marketplace/purchase with a valid marketplace game -> Receive 200 purchase success -> Game is added to the buyer's library
GET /api/marketplace/my-sales -> Receive seller sales history -> Teacher reviews revenue and transactions
GET /api/admin/marketplace/pending as admin -> Receive pending listings -> POST /api/admin/marketplace/[id]/approve -> Receive approved listing -> Game becomes public in marketplace
POST /api/admin/marketplace/[id]/reject with admin credentials and listing id -> Receive 200 rejected listing -> Listing remains unpublished
POST /api/marketplace/purchase with missing payment or unavailable listing -> Receive error response -> Purchase does not complete

features.name: Billing and Subscriptions
features.description: Teachers can view plans, subscribe, cancel subscriptions, and review billing history using the billing system.
user_flows: GET /api/billing/plans -> Receive available subscription plans -> Teacher selects Pro or Ultimate -> POST /api/billing/subscribe with plan details -> Receive checkout/subscription initiation
POST /api/billing/subscribe with authenticated user and valid plan -> Receive 200 subscription started -> GET /api/billing/history -> Receive updated billing history
POST /api/billing/cancel with active subscription -> Receive 200 cancellation success -> GET /api/billing/history -> Show cancelled status
GET /api/billing/history with authenticated user -> Receive billing records -> Teacher reviews prior invoices and subscription events
POST /api/billing/webhook from payment provider -> Receive 200 processed webhook -> Subscription state is synchronized
POST /api/billing/subscribe with invalid plan or unauthenticated request -> Receive 401/400 error -> No subscription is created

features.name: Admin Management
features.description: Administrators can manage users, settings, stats, and subscription-related platform controls.
user_flows: GET /api/admin/users as admin -> Receive list of users -> PATCH /api/admin/users/[id] -> Receive updated user data -> GET /api/admin/stats -> Receive platform statistics
PUT /api/admin/settings with updated platform configuration -> Receive 200 settings saved -> Admin dashboard reflects new settings
GET /api/admin/stats with admin credentials -> Receive usage and growth metrics -> Admin can review system activity
GET /api/admin/users with non-admin credentials -> Receive authorization error -> User list is not returned
PATCH /api/admin/users/[id] with invalid role or blocked user action -> Receive error response -> No user change is applied

features.name: Branding and Custom Domain
features.description: Teachers can customize branding settings and verify a custom domain for their educational workspace.
user_flows: GET /api/branding -> Receive current branding settings -> PUT /api/branding with new logo/colors -> Receive 200 branding updated -> GET /api/branding -> See updated values
POST /api/branding/domain/verify with domain details -> Receive 200 verification result -> Custom domain status is stored
PUT /api/branding with missing required branding fields -> Receive validation error -> Branding remains unchanged
POST /api/branding/domain/verify with invalid domain ownership or DNS setup -> Receive verification error -> Domain is not approved

features.name: Media Upload
features.description: Teachers can upload images and audio files to enrich games, lessons, and activity content.
user_flows: POST /api/upload/image with authenticated teacher and image file -> Receive 200 uploaded image URL -> Teacher inserts image into a game or lesson
POST /api/upload/audio with authenticated teacher and audio file -> Receive 200 uploaded audio URL -> Teacher uses it in listening or speaking activities
POST /api/upload/image with unsupported file type or oversized file -> Receive validation error -> No file is stored
POST /api/upload/audio with missing authentication or invalid media -> Receive 401/400 error -> Upload is rejected

features.name: Courses and Lessons
features.description: Teachers can create courses, manage lessons, generate lesson content, and publish course materials for students.
user_flows: POST /api/courses with authenticated teacher and course details -> Receive 200 course created -> GET /api/courses/[id] -> Receive course data -> PATCH /api/courses/[id] -> Receive updated course
POST /api/courses/[id]/publish with complete course content -> Receive 200 published course -> Course becomes available for learners
GET /api/courses -> Receive list of courses -> Teacher selects a course to edit or expand
POST /api/courses with missing required fields or invalid authentication -> Receive validation or authorization error -> Course is not created
POST /api/lessons/[id]/generate with a lesson and AI content request -> Receive generated lesson content -> Lesson is enriched with AI-assisted material

features.name: Educational Game Engines
features.description: Students and teachers can interact with multiple browser-based game engines for learning, including teacher preview and student play views.
user_flows: GET /play/game/[id] without authentication -> Receive public student/visitor game view -> User can start playing the game
GET /learn/game/[id] with authenticated teacher -> Receive teacher learning/preview view -> Teacher can inspect how the game works before assigning it
GET /play/game/[id] with an invalid game id -> Receive not found response -> Game cannot be opened
GET /learn/game/[id] without authentication -> Receive authorization error -> Teacher preview view is not returned
